title: ApplyEvidenceEventResult v1
description: Result of node.apply_evidence_event: one evidence artifact caused a batch of per-node lifecycle dispositions, applied atomically. Every node row records its transition; the shared event_group ties the batch's mutation-log entries to this event and the ledger carries the evidence_ref on each entry — the group binding is engine-recorded, never a caller-side key-naming convention.

event_group.description: Deterministic group id derived from the request payload hash; identical on idempotent replay.

evidence_ref.description: The project-portable, hash-bound reference of the evidence artifact that caused the batch. Stored verbatim (like report_ref / survey_ref); whether the artifact supports the dispositions stays a project-side audit concern.
